description: Defines an API endpoint class for creating new catalog items within the eShopWeb application, including route setup, request handling, validation, and response construction.

classes.name: CreateCatalogItemEndpoint
classes.description: An API endpoint class handling the creation of catalog items, including route mapping and request processing.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Sets up the HTTP POST route for creating catalog items with authorization and endpoint tags.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Processes the creation request, checks for duplicates, adds the new item, updates its picture URI, and returns the created item response.
